collection.title: Volvo S80 2006 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Volvo S80 Saloon 2006 - 2016 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
